## Draft: Not Published

This page is a draft for the site visual plan (#5427). Publishing it needs
Dieter's approval and the Assessment Board gate.
:::

The branched zero-torque counterfactual (ZTCF) asks what the club would do if
every joint torque were switched off at one instant, with the swing branching
from there. The video below steps through that question on a simple
three-link model.

It is not a traced UpstreamDrift render and not physically accepted motion: no traced render exists yet (site audit #5423; best-match model pending UpstreamDrift #14442)." >}}
